description: Saves a draft reply to a message in the signed-in person's Outlook mailbox, in the same conversation. Does not send the message. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

body.description: Plain-text reply. The quoted original is added by Outlook.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key on a retry replays the first save without writing twice.

message_id.description: The message to reply to, from search_outlook_email or get_outlook_thread.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

reply_all.description: Reply to everyone on the message. Defaults to false.

name: draft_outlook_reply
title: Draft an Outlook reply
